company.name: ILLA
company.shortDescription: ILLA is an asset-light FMCG-focused middle mile delivery logistics company.
company.description:
ILLA is an asset-light FMCG-focused middle mile delivery logistics company.

The company manages the delivery process from planning to execution by digitizing each step of the delivery process by monitoring our clients’ logistics activities to optimize it and converted to sales growth. It also provides a dynamic solution that helps its clients overcome the daily market challenges of delivering products to different types of retail and non-retail outlets.

ILLA connects FMCG companies with a large network of trucks with different types and capacities to act as an internal fleet to provide full control and visibility over the driver.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 78.13% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $770,883 to $11,503,555, a 14.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
